subject: SOC 2 Type II: initial asset & evidence intake + reply snippets
messages:
From: Eva Lopez <eva.lopez@auditaservices.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sam.tyler@nimbusanalytics.com, itsecurity@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and list of standard artifacts

Hi Grace,

Hope you’re well — I’m Eva from AuditA Services, assigned to Nimbus Analytics’ vendor controls review. Nimbus asked us to obtain your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and any applicable bridge letter for the audit period that covers Q4 2024–Q2 2025 (they were told Redwood completed Type II for calendar 2024). To make the intake efficient, can you provide: 

- The final SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and an executive summary (if distinct).
- A bridge letter if the report period doesn’t align with Nimbus’s audit window.
- A short inventory of evidence artifacts you can share (control owners, log retention extracts, sample configs, policy docs).
- Any secure links (SFTP/Drive) or transfer instructions you prefer.

If you can’t share certain artifacts publicly, a list of available artifact types and an estimate of how long secure delivery would take is sufficient for now. Nimbus also asked for a couple of boilerplate reply snippets we can use when drafting their internal control mapping. Could you include 2–3 short templates we can copy into their vendor spreadsheet (one for full report available, one for bridge letter only, one for controls-in-progress)?

Thanks — if easier, we can take a quick 20-min call later today.

Best,
Eva
Eva Lopez
Senior Manager, Vendor Audit
AuditA Services
[attachment: audit-intake-checklist.pdf (pdf, 90KB)]

From: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
To: eva.lopez@auditaservices.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, sam.tyler@nimbusanalytics.com, itsecurity@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and list of standard artifacts

Hi Eva — thanks for the clear asks and the checklist. Happy to help. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

Summary of what we can share now:
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (calendar 2024) — full PDF attached (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_2024.pdf).
- Bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter that documents coverage up to 2024 and clarifies any gaps for Nimbus’s audit window; sample attached (bridge_letter_sample.docx).
- Evidence inventory: we can share a categorized inventory (logs, IAM configs, change management tickets, monitoring alerts, policy docs). We don’t share raw tickets by default but provide redacted samples or extracts on request.

Preferred transfer method:
- Secure Drive folder (link below) for report and non-sensitive artifacts.
- For sensitive exports (retention logs, redacted configs) we prefer a signed NDA + DocuSign envelope or SFTP — we can stage within 48–72 hours after request.

Reply snippets (copy/paste friendly):
1) Full report available: 
"Redwood Inference has provided the SOC 2 Type II report covering calendar 2024. The report and executive summary are stored in a secure folder and accessible to authorized Nimbus personnel. For detailed artifact requests, please submit a scoped list and we will coordinate secure delivery."

2) Bridge letter only (report period mismatch):
"Redwood has completed a SOC 2 Type II assessment for calendar year 2024. Where Nimbus’s audit window extends beyond that period, Redwood can provide a bridge letter that documents continued controls and any relevant changes; please advise required coverage dates."

3) Controls-in-progress / partial evidence: 
"Certain operational artifacts (e.g., recent change tickets, raw logs) are available as redacted extracts or via secure transfer. Please provide a prioritized list of samples and we will produce redacted exports within an agreed timeframe."

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll upload the report and the bridge-letter sample to a secure folder now and share link.
- If you need raw extracts, reply with the specific artifacts and control IDs (e.g., CC-02: IAM provisioning logs) and we’ll provide an estimated delivery window.

Sharing link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-evidence-folder

If Nimbus prefers a call this afternoon, I’m available 1:30–3:30pm PT.

Best,
Grace O’Connor
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_2024.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB)]

From: Sam Tyler <sam.tyler@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: eva.lopez@auditaservices.com, itsecurity@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and list of standard artifacts

Grace — thanks, that’s helpful. Two quick clarifications from our side: 
1) Nimbus needs coverage for the audit period Feb 1, 2025 — Jan 31, 2026. Does the bridge letter sample describe how you map operational changes since calendar 2024?
2) For the prioritized artifacts, are redacted IAM provisioning exports possible within 5 business days? We only need a 30-sample extract for our testing.

If you can confirm these two points, I’ll instruct AuditA to accept the drive link for the report and then we can request specific extracts.

Thanks,
Sam
Head of Procurement & Vendor Risk
Nimbus Analytics

From: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
To: sam.tyler@nimbusanalytics.com, eva.lopez@auditaservices.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, itsecurity@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and list of standard artifacts

Sam — quick answers: 
1) Bridge letter scope: yes, the bridge letter template we provided includes a narrative on control continuity and a mapping of material changes through Jan 2026. We’ll tailor wording to your exact Feb 1, 2025–Jan 31, 2026 window.
2) IAM export timeline: we can produce a redacted 30-sample IAM provisioning export within 4 business days once we have the sample criteria (date range, event types). We will need a signed transfer agreement for exports.

I’ll mark this action item and follow up with a DocuSign link for the transfer agreement by end of day.

Regards,
Grace
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: sam.tyler@nimbusanalytics.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: eva.lopez@auditaservices.com, itsecurity@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter and list of standard artifacts

Sam — looping in a quick checklist from our intake playbook to speed this: 
- Confirm audit window: Feb 01, 2025 — Jan 31, 2026 (you already did).
- Specify control IDs or artifact types you want (e.g., IAM provisioning, change mgmt ticket IDs, retention logs).
- Sign transfer agreement (DocuSign) for redacted exports.
- We’ll stage report + bridge letter in secure folder within 24 hours; extracts after agreement signed (4 business days for IAM sample).

Copy/paste snippet for your internal vendor tracker (short):
"Redwood Inference — SOC 2 Type II (calendar 2024). Full report available; bridge letter to extend coverage to Feb 1, 2025–Jan 31, 2026. Redacted artifacts available on request after transfer agreement (est. 4 business days for IAM export)."

Happy to join a call if useful.

—Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Customer Security Ops
Redwood Inference
